spec.purpose: Measure completed phases on the qualified paired-GDN1, fused-PV1, compact-MoE1 and adaptive-OUT2 stack, retaining every artifact and numerical option from the uninstrumented q8192/out512 baseline. Only five completed profile flags and disabled marker filtering differ. Require all512 original GB10 IDs, callbacks and first logit within0.125. CK probability phase now includes native PV; the native-PV phase is an empty completion boundary. Nested and overlapping intervals are not additive; negative or nonfinite device timings are invalid. Instrumented TTFT is not a new performance baseline.

phase_analysis.ck_probability_stage_scope: Softmax and native PV are fused in probability_ms; approximate_pv_ms is an empty completion boundary. Do not compare either field alone with an unfused profile.

timing_scope: Same-artifact paired-GDN, fused-PV, compact-MoE and adaptive-OUT stack with five profile options and marker filtering disabled. Linear core stages are disjoint internally; preceding projections are separate. CK completed phases are nested in full attention; its probability phase includes native PV and its approximate-PV phase is only an empty completion boundary; first lazy EXP initialization is outside the internal CK profile but remains included in outer full-attention and first-callback TTFT. Routed and shared MoE overlap. Dense correction excludes the matrix producer; coarse OUT includes preparation, producer, replay and conversion. Device-event negative/nonfinite values are preserved as invalid and excluded from totals. Instrumentation overhead remains; this is no retained-performance result.

decision.decision: Preserve the same-artifact paired-GDN, fused-PV, compact-MoE and adaptive-OUT control. This completed profile revalidates every original GB10 token and callback. Linear core is7146.189ms with4355.962ms preceding projections; full attention is9147.449ms including QK3198.0921ms and exact PV1739.2244ms; MoE total is4953.600652ms. Nested and overlapping clocks are not additive. Layer39 full-prefix attention alone is894.791ms although the cold next-token head consumes its last row. Investigate final-layer query/output liveness with complete original KV and exact arithmetic, considering the existing terminal route and subsequent q1 arithmetic repairs. This is an unmeasured hypothesis, not a qualified replacement; broader arithmetic/dataflow changes remain necessary for the10-second mission. The scaled-half QK experiment remains isolated because its full component gain is modest.
decision.invalid_timing_scope: All ten full-attention residual_postnorm device intervals are negative; preserve raw values and exclude them from aggregates. No MoE interval is negative in this run.
